app_info.subtitle: LaTeX Resume Builder
app_info.description: Create, update, compile, and email professional LaTeX resumes from ChatGPT. ResumeForge connects to a user's account, retrieves their master resume JSON, saves confirmed edits, generates polished PDF resumes from structured data, and can email the finished PDF to the user's inbox.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only because it only retrieves the authenticated user's stored master resume JSON and does not modify backend state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it only reads data from ResumeForge's own backend for the authenticated user and does not contact third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it does not perform any update, deletion, or overwrite operations on any user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it replaces the authenticated user's stored master resume JSON after validation.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it writes only to ResumeForge's own backend storage and does not send data to external third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it updates one user-owned resume document rather than deleting accounts, wiping history, or removing unrelated data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it performs a server-side PDF compilation job and creates a new output file.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because compilation happens entirely inside ResumeForge's own infrastructure without calling external APIs or third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it generates a new PDF artifact and does not delete or overwrite the user's stored resume by itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it initiates an outbound email delivery action instead of only returning stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is open world because it sends a message to an external email destination over SMTP infrastructure outside the current ChatGPT session.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it only transmits an email message and does not delete or overwrite any user records or system data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only because it returns a static list of supported resume templates and their metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it returns template metadata from ResumeForge's own backend and does not reach external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it is a read-only metadata retrieval and does not modify any state or database entries.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can retrieve the list of available LaTeX templates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the available resume templates.
test_cases.expected_output: Should list templates including 'executive' with their names and descriptions.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can successfully retrieve the authenticated user's master resume.
test_cases.expected_output: Should return the authenticated user's stored resume JSON, including header fields and section data if a master resume already exists.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can save a validated change to the master resume after the user requests an edit.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update my master resume by adding a new bullet under my most recent role: Improved PDF generation reliability and reduced compile failures.
test_cases.expected_output: Should retrieve the current resume, apply the requested edit in structured JSON, save it successfully, and confirm that the master resume was updated.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can compile a PDF from resume JSON using the supported template.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a PDF of my current resume using the executive template.
test_cases.expected_output: Should retrieve the current resume and return a successful PDF generation result containing a relative PDF URL such as /pdf/<job-id>/main.pdf.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can email the PDF that was just generated to the user's registered email address.
test_cases.user_prompt: Email the PDF you just generated to my account email.
test_cases.expected_output: Should send the generated PDF URL to the authenticated user's email address and confirm successful delivery or provide the development preview URL if the app is using a test SMTP account.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that retrieving the master resume fails gracefully when the user's session is expired or not authenticated.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should prompt the user to log in or authorize the app, displaying an authentication error message.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that saving the master resume fails when the payload has an invalid structure that violates the JSON Schema.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update my master resume but set the header to null.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should refuse to save the change, surface a schema validation error, and leave the existing master resume unchanged.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant does not attempt to email a resume before it has a PDF URL to send.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should ask the user to generate a PDF first or otherwise obtain a valid PDF URL before attempting the email action.
